body:
Adds `research/safety-twin` (stylised, pure Python, 9 tests): a corridor-keeping margin certified in a Gaussian-disturbance twin fails under same-variance Student-t gusts (real failure 0.29 at a claimed 0.01, ν=3); needed margin 7.3× at δ=0.001; variance inflation misses by 24×; conformal repair needs n≥1/δ; a Hill tail fit from one-step data repairs it. README bullet and site/projects.json entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
